gates.command: uv run ruff check scripts/analyze_secondary_metrics.py tests/test_analyze_secondary_metrics.py

adversarial_findings_resolved: Recovery duration greater than declared release-to-delivery wall time is rejected.
A recovery never achieved may carry null resume time rather than a fabricated zero.
A missing interruption leaves R missing without deleting available T, W or P.
Human wait below the audited receipt wait is rejected; extra wait outside attempts is retained.
Human event counts and active seconds are reported by type; declared active parts must sum to the declared total.
Resolved critical incident identifiers are counted once per run and type, separately from binary E.
Missing required observations and a zero S median cannot yield a favorable aggregate or ratio.

independent_read_only_review.result: initial temporal, human and incident findings plus recovery-specific missing and active-time breakdown reproduced, corrected and rechecked; no further concrete false green in that scope

not_performed: No original judge files, reference, audit, injection, human event, release, invoice or rate-card bytes authenticated by this analyzer.
No model/provider telemetry, tariff, identity, blinding, custody or independent timestamp verified.
No confidence intervals for secondary effects, full API/system wait decomposition or model-agent-tool token decomposition computed.
No real N/SDD/toolkit matrix, ablations, field site, approved value equivalence or observed impact.
